dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Observed five prominent ring structures on the mid-lateral flank. Three exhibit closed 'O' geometries with sharp high-contrast outer perimeters and low-intensity interiors. Two exhibit fragmented 'C' shaped geometries with irregular, scalloped outer edges located dorsally to the primary 'O' cluster.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, irregular high-intensity pixel clusters concentrated along the dorsal ridge and interspersed between the macro-annuli. A dense cluster of solid low-intensity pixels is located on the anterior dorsal surface, lacking an internal gradient.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest 'O' rings form a scalene triangle on the mid-lateral surface. The spatial relationship between the primary 'O' ring and the two nearest dorsal 'C' shapes forms an obtuse angular relationship of approximately 130 degrees.
